# AVE MUNDO

> AVE MUNDO a.s. is a boutique investment holding for AI, e-commerce, and SaaS companies in the European Union. We accelerate portfolio growth through capital, know-how, data, and AI — building long-term value, not single bets.

AVE MUNDO is **not** a VC fund, accelerator, or agency. It is a holding company that operates a shared ecosystem across its portfolio companies. Founded by Czech entrepreneurs with two decades of building, scaling, and exiting startups.

## Identity

- **Legal name:** AVE MUNDO a.s. (Czech joint-stock company)
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Headquarters:** Poštovní 244, 739 61 Třinec, Czech Republic
- **Company ID (IČO):** 19576749

- **Commercial register:** Regional Court in Ostrava, Section B, Insert 11527

## Founders

- **Adam Kurzok** — Co-founder & Managing Partner. Two decades in startups and e-commerce. Founded Lunchtime and Pizzatime (exited to Zomato & Delivery Hero), EXPANDO, DIGISMOOTHIE. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/adamkurzok/
- **Igor Třeslín** — Co-founder & Partner. Two decades in sales leadership and C-level roles. Founded Storyous (exited to Teya). Worked with Rockaway and Saltpay investment funds. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/igor-treslin-99a02422/

## Portfolio Companies

- **EXPANDO** — Largest CEE marketplace agency and marketplace connectors platform. https://expan.do
- **LOCO** — Autonomous AI agent team for e-commerce localisation.
- **BEHAVERA** — Transforms behavioral data into actionable insights.

## Investment thesis

AVE MUNDO partners with founders and investors who think in portfolios, not single bets. We back companies that are:

- **Global by default** — designed for markets beyond their local one
- **Software- and data-driven** — software at the core, data as a moat
- **Built to scale** beyond ten engineers and one geography
- **Built for long-term value**, not short-term hype

Sectors of focus: E-commerce infrastructure, SaaS, AI/automation, cross-border commerce.

Geography: European Union (Czech Republic, CEE region preferred but not required).

Stage: Post-product-market-fit. Companies with traction, revenue, or clear monetisation path.

## Value we provide to portfolio companies

- **Capital** — aligned, long-horizon, built for compounding rather than quick exits
- **Know-how** — strategy, go-to-market, product. Operator depth across the portfolio
- **Data and reporting** — KPI-driven decisions through shared dashboards and honest numbers
- **AI and automation** — scalable execution, less ops friction, more compounding
- **Strategic partnership** — product, market, positioning
- **Go-to-market support** across EU and beyond
- **Shared infrastructure** — data, reporting, AI, automation tooling

## How we work with founders

- Founders keep operational autonomy
- We optimize for direction, speed, and compounding effects
- Focus on building an asset, not just a product
- Long-term horizons, no quarterly pressure
